newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKEY CLOSES BORDER TO IRAQ FOR ARMY DRIVE.
newsitem.headline: TURKEY CLOSES BORDER TO IRAQ FOR ARMY DRIVE.

text.p: Turkey closed its only border crossing to northern Iraq on Wednesday after a military move against separatist Kurdish rebels, officials said.

They said the Habur border gate was closed early in the morning before several thousand Turkish troops, backed by tanks and artillery, pushed into northern Iraq to oust guerrillas of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK).

Habur has been used since December as one of the outlets for U.N.-monitored food sales to Iraq as part of the oil-for-food deal, which allowed Baghdad to sell oil worth $2 billion to buy food and medicine.
Hundreds of Turkish trucks have been carrying food to northern Iraq to buy cheap Iraqi diesel apart from the U.N. controlled sales.
